precision_idioms.name: must_never_invariant
precision_idioms.template: X must never Y; verified by Z.
precision_idioms.example: By default, you cannot delete the default payment method on an account (because it is assumed to be used for recurring payments).

precision_idioms.name: exactly_once
precision_idioms.template: Action happens at most/exactly once per X (period, object, cycle).
precision_idioms.example: Reminders are sent once per invoice per stage — the same reminder is never sent twice for the same invoice.

precision_idioms.name: explicit_requirement
precision_idioms.template: Field X is required; error if omitted.

edge_case_patterns.name: duplicate_submission
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Batch sends are marked to prevent re-triggering the same manual process.

edge_case_patterns.name: partial_delivery
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Only invoice for what was actually delivered, supporting multiple invoices for partial deliveries/back orders.

edge_case_patterns.name: partial_payment
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Allows recording less-than-invoice amounts and resolves the difference using write-offs.

edge_case_patterns.name: abandoned_checkout
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Track abandoned purchases optionally by creating a PENDING payment at form creation, completed only if returned or notified.

edge_case_patterns.name: archived_invoice_visibility
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Archived invoices are excluded from active and outstanding calculations but remain viewable.

edge_case_patterns.name: backdated_entry
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Allows explicit configuration for editing posting date/time for backdated entries, ensuring proper documentation.

edge_case_patterns.name: cancelled_invoice_recovery
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Cancellation cannot be undone in UI; recovery requires cloning and re-issuing.

edge_case_patterns.name: category_specific_payment_exclusion
edge_case_patterns.resolution: Allows disabling payment methods for specific categories to prevent invalid combinations.
